title: Core-only authority writer and neutral writer capabilities
summary: `StoresGrants` is no longer supported SPI: the core database storage is the only authority writer, `Panel::writer()` returns `?Schema\WriterSchema` and `PanelSchema::writer()` exposes writable/dynamic-permission/roles-only capabilities; Filament reads capabilities and converts Gate results only through supported API.
why: D10: the coordinator, managers and Filament accept only `DatabaseSource`, so a published writer SPI promises what core rejects; UIs need capabilities, not a concrete source class (architecture#spi-catalog neutral contracts). Hard risk: every write path (ChangePipeline, RoleKeyMigration, ScopedGrantManager, Authorizer, console commands) must still reach the same DatabaseSource through an internal accessor; I6 write guards stay green.

include: New `Schema\WriterSchema` (Api) exactly as knowledge/contracts#schema; `PanelSchema::writer(): ?WriterSchema`; `Panel::writer(): ?WriterSchema` (null = read-only panel)

Retire `Contracts\Sources\StoresGrants` (type-map retire row): `DatabaseSource` keeps its methods without the interface; core write paths obtain the writer through an `@internal` accessor (e.g. `Panel::writerSource()` or `Sources\PanelSources`), never through supported API
`Testing\Contracts\SourceContractTests` writer cases become internal tests (D10 consequence) — they move to tests/ and leave the shipped contract suite

Filament: `Resources\PermissionResource` uses `PanelSchema::writer()?->dynamicPermissions` instead of `DatabaseSource::isDynamic()`; `Authorization\FilamentGate` uses the supported Laravel adapter method for Gate results (`Laravel\GateBridge::toGateResult()` attributed per its type-map row, or the row's named replacement) — I4 entries removed
Doctor/explain/`azguard:panels:list --schema` output gains the writer capabilities only if PanelSchema JSON is part of it (snapshot regenerated deliberately)
Migration lines: StoresGrants retired, Panel::writer() type, PanelSchema::writer()
exclude: Making the write coordinator writer-agnostic (new feature, rejected by D10)
